We compare the CO(1-0) and H$\alpha$ kinematics in 34 nearby galaxies, selected from the ALMaQUEST and EDGE-CALIFA surveys.
In this study, with the selected 34 nearby galaxies from the combined ALMaQUEST and EDGE-CALIFA dataset, we aim to further investigate the CO-H$\alpha$ velocity discrepancy with a larger sample size.
The ALMaQUEST Survey contains $^{12}$CO(J=1-0; 115.2712 GHz) MaNGA follow-up observation for 46 galaxies with ALMA in the C43-2 configuration.
The spectral resolution of $^{12}CO(1-0)$ for ALMaQUEST galaxies is $\sigma_{inst}\approx$11 km/s.
The ALMaQUEST Survey contains $^{12}$CO(J=1-0; 115.2712 GHz) MaNGA follow-up observation for 46 galaxies with ALMA in the C43-2 configuration.
The ALMaQUEST Survey contains $^{12}$CO(J=1-0; 115.2712 GHz) MaNGA follow-up observation for 46 galaxies with ALMA in the C43-2 configuration.
The field of view for each galaxy is $\sim$50$^{\prime\prime}_{^\textrm{.}}$ with spatial resolution $\sim$2$^{\prime\prime}_{^\textrm{.}}$5, which matches the MaNGA resolution.
Mapping Nearby Galaxies at APO (MaNGA; (cite: 2015ApJ...798....7B)) is an integral field unit (IFU) survey as part of the SDSS-IV.
The H$\alpha$ data cubes for MaNGA galaxies are based on the SDSS Data Release 15 (DR15) analyzed through the MaNGA reduction pipeline (cite: 2016AJ....152...83L).
CALIFA used PPAK IFU (cite: 2006PASP..118..129K) on the Calar Alto 3.5m telescope.
The H$\alpha$ data cubes for CALIFA galaxies are taken from the PIPE3D Dataproducts (cite: 2016RMxAA..52...21S; 2016RMxAA..52..171S).

Extragalactic Database for Galaxy Evolution (EDGE) survey (cite: 2017ApJ...846..159B) comprises $^{12}$CO(J=1-0; 115.2712 GHz) measurement for 126 nearby galaxies with CARMA in the D and E configurations.
The spatial resolution of EDGE data is $\sim$4$^{\prime\prime}_{^\textrm{.}}$5, corresponding to the physical scale between 0.6 and 2.4 kpc for the EDGE sample included in this study.

The global SFR, stellar mass and the $\Sigma_*$ of the MaNGA galaxies used in this work are taken from the PIPE3D (cite: 2016RMxAA..52...21S; 2016RMxAA..52..171S) value-added catalog (cite: 2018RMxAA..54..217S).
The H$\alpha$ intensity maps and the EW($\alpha$) maps are taken from the MaNGA DR15 PIPE3D value-added products ((cite: 2016RMxAA..52...21S; 2016RMxAA..52..171S)).

We note that for the low EW(H$\alpha$) group, the ADC might not be accurate because of the following reasons: (i) the presence of eDIG ”contaminates” the H$\alpha$ velocity dispersion on the mid-plane; (ii) the assumption we made in Sec.[5.2](#sec:sec5.2) (e.g. thin disk, constant scale height, etc) is no longer valid.
The H$\alpha$ data cubes for MaNGA galaxies are based on the SDSS Data Release 15 (DR15) analyzed through the MaNGA reduction pipeline (cite: 2016AJ....152...83L).
The H$\alpha$ data cubes for CALIFA galaxies are taken from the PIPE3D Dataproducts (cite: 2016RMxAA..52...21S; 2016RMxAA..52..171S).
More details in the ALMaQUEST survey can be found in (cite: 2020ApJ...903..145L).
